items.text: "What Do I Do "What "What Do I Do "What do I do with an MA" is not really about the subject anymore. By the time the degree is done, the subject has already given you what it is going to give you: a research base, a way of reading and arguing, maybe a specific syllabus overlap with an exam.

items.heading: Ask One Person Already Inside
items.text: Ask One Person Already Inside Ask one person already inside your target door, a JRF scholar, a PGT teacher, a State PSC officer, or a corporate hire in your field, what an ordinary week actually looks like, not the highlight-reel version.

rows: People who want to start earning within months and are willing to add one visible, market-facing skill on top of the MA.

Entry-level pay is often modest (roughly Rs 3-6 LPA) without a multiplier skill, but the pay ceiling and speed to first income both beat the other three doors, and that same skill layer opens a path to independent, scalable work later.
Teaching (school PGT/TGT, or college via NET)
People who want structured hours, direct classroom work, and a path that starts paying sooner than research or civil services.
School PGT posts typically pay Rs 30,000-55,000 a month in government schools; private schools often pay less. College teaching needs NET or a PhD first.
People who want to keep working inside the subject itself and are fine with a slow, funded runway before a stable salary.
JRF stipend runs roughly Rs 37,000-42,000 a month; a PhD typically takes 3-6 years; a permanent assistant professor post is not guaranteed even after NET and a PhD.
People who want the widest generalist government career and can fund 1-3 serious attempts without needing income immediately.
The overall UPSC CSE selection ratio was roughly 0.1% in the 2025 cycle. State PSCs have softer odds but far lower pay and slower recruitment cycles.

items.heading: Sit One Real Past Net
items.text: Sit one real past NET or UPSC paper under exam conditions and score it honestly, instead of estimating your readiness from how the syllabus reads on paper.

items.heading: Apply for One Real Opening
items.text: Apply for one real opening in the corporate or teaching lane even while academia or civil services stays your first choice, so you have live market feedback instead of a theory.

items.heading: Give the Test As Long
items.text: Give the test as long as it genuinely takes. Some people know within a few weeks whether a door fits; others need a couple of months of real exposure and one honest conversation before the picture is clear.
